attributes.board_name: North Dakota State Board of Dental Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Publications, seminars, symposiums, lectures, college courses and online education; clinical dentistry subject matter accepted without limit; certificates must name provider, date and hours
rules.audit_note: Renewal application includes proof of CE completion (NDCC 43-28-16.2). Board may audit; keep records from the previous cycle.

topics.who: Ethics or jurisprudence; passing the laws and rules exam counts as 2 h
Can be met by a federal OSHA course for dental providers
Hands-on CPR course each cycle and current CPR certificate

rules.notes: Max 16 h self-study; live real-time online counts. Hands-on CPR course each cycle and current CPR certificate required. Sedation/anesthesia permit holders: 6 h sedation/anesthesia + 2 h anesthesia emergencies; simulation training from 2028. Max 2 h practice management.
rules.rule_quote: The minimum number of hours required within a two-year cycle for dentists is thirty-two.
